_about: casaslegales.com English (/en/): for Argentines and people in Argentina who read English. keep = names that stay as written (also allowed by the Spanish-words gate on /en/ pages); terms = Argentine legal and betting words, kept in Spanish with a short gloss where the reader needs it, or translated as shown. Used by tools/translate.mjs (docs/I18N.md).
audience: Argentines (and people living in Argentina) who prefer English and want to know which betting sites are licensed in their province. Same Argentine substance as the Spanish site: 24 jurisdictions, provincial regulators, Argentine pesos, Argentine help lines. Plain, neutral American English, second person (you) for the Spanish vos. Short sentences, factual and careful: this is a legal-status site with no affiliate links. No new claims, no advice, no hype.
money: Amounts are Argentine pesos written "$ 1,234" (dollar sign, space, English separators); never convert to US dollars; say "pesos" where the Spanish says pesos.
time: Dates are written by code; times stay on the 24-hour clock; "hora argentina" = "Argentina time".
urlRule: "/en" + the Spanish path with English section words, NO trailing slash, same depth; the home "/" is "/en". Section words: operador -> operator, operadores -> operators, provincia -> province, provincias -> provinces, verificar -> check, verificador -> site-checker, licencias -> licenses, guia -> guide, calculadora -> calculator, juego-responsable -> responsible-gambling. Brand slugs and province slugs stay exactly as in the Spanish path (/operador/betsson/caba -> /en/operator/betsson/caba, /provincia/cordoba -> /en/province/cordoba); ingresar -> log-in; casino stays casino. Descriptive words in English (glosario -> glossary, margen -> margin, cuotas -> odds, combinada -> parlay, autoexclusion -> self-exclusion). Unique.
